# CoGrader

> CoGrader is an AI-powered essay grading platform that helps teachers save time on assessment while providing students with instant, standards-aligned feedback.

CoGrader serves over 1000 schools across the United States with a comprehensive suite of K-12 grading and assessment tools. The platform integrates with major learning management systems like Google Classroom, Canvas, and Schoology, and includes plagiarism detection, AI rubric generation, and professional development resources for educators.

## Key Topics

- AI essay grading
- Rubric-based grading
- Standards-aligned assessment
- Google Classroom integration
- Plagiarism detection
- Automated feedback
- Teacher productivity
- Writing assessment
- FERPA compliance
- Common Core standards
- AP Exam preparation
- Elementary/Middle/High School grading
- Canvas and Schoology support
- Student data privacy
- Professional development for teachers

## Core Grading Tools

- [AI Essay Grader for Teachers](https://cograder.com/ai-essay-grader): Main product page for CoGrader's rubric-based AI essay grading tool
- [AI Grading Tool](https://cograder.com/ai-grading): Core AI grading tool supporting essays and open-ended questions with Google Classroom integration
- [Assessment Platform](https://cograder.com/assessment-platform): Comprehensive assessment platform for standards-aligned essay scoring
- [Plagiarism Checker & AI Detector](https://cograder.com/plagiarism-checker): CoGrader's plagiarism and AI detection feature for essay assessment
- [AI Rubric Generator](https://cograder.com/ai-rubric-generator): AI-powered rubric generator aligned to CCSS and state standards for essay grading

## Grade-Level Solutions

- [AI Essay Grader for Elementary School](https://cograder.com/ai-grader-elementary-school): CoGrader's AI grading tool tailored for elementary school writing assessment
- [AI Grader for Middle School](https://cograder.com/ai-grader-middle-school): AI essay grader for middle school with Common Core rubrics for grades 6-8
- [AI Grader for High School](https://cograder.com/ai-grader-high-school): AI essay grader for high school featuring AP-aligned rubrics and instant feedback
- [AP History Essay Grader](https://cograder.com/ap-history): Specialized AI grader for AP History DBQ, LEQ, and SAQ essay assessment

## State Standards Solutions

- [CoGrader for Texas Teachers](https://cograder.com/states/texas): Texas-specific AI grading tool aligned to STAAR and TEKS standards for grades 3-12
- [CoGrader for Florida Teachers](https://cograder.com/states/florida): Florida-specific AI essay grader aligned to B.E.S.T. and FAST standards
- [CoGrader for California Teachers](https://cograder.com/states/california): California-specific grading tool aligned to CAASPP Smarter Balanced standards
- [CoGrader for New York Teachers](https://cograder.com/states/new-york): New York-specific AI grader aligned to Regents and Next Generation Learning Standards

## School & District Solutions

- [AI Grading for Schools](https://cograder.com/schools): CoGrader's school-wide AI grading solution with FERPA compliance and equity features
- [AI Professional Development for Teachers](https://cograder.com/schools/professional-development-for-teachers): Professional development workshops on ethical AI use and integration in education
